sentences.en: No matter how vigorous the lie, you cannot escape the truth.
sentences.zh: 无论谎言多么有活力，你也逃不脱事实。

sentences.en: You will be more vigorous if you exercise.
sentences.zh: 如果你锻炼的话，你会更有活力。

sentences.en: The vigorous man is engaged in diverse activities.
sentences.zh: 那个充满活力的人参与了多种多样的活动。

senses.zh: 精力旺盛的：active strength；强健的：withstand hardship
